unsupported: The school launched its first classes in the fall of 2018, founded by Jonathan Cohen in response to longstanding demand for a high-caliber woodworking institution in the Pacific Northwest.
Cohen, a veteran woodworker who has spoken publicly on the craft, established the school to deliver the highest level of instruction in furniture design and construction.
Its graduates move into fields such as custom furniture making, cabinetry, musical instrument construction, boatbuilding, and architectural woodworking.
The program also attracts hobbyists and career-changers looking for rigorous, hands-on training.
